answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bond that unlocks only after a long, public thread of useful work: each completed job appends a signed receipt, and reputation accrues slowly, like crossing a tundra. A sonnet of praise from its own sock puppets counts for nothing, because receipts must come from independent, paying clients who have staked themselves. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds and paying real fees, while one detected fraud slashes the bond and burns the thread, so a sybil farm loses more than honest work earns.
